chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Touring by train and car
summary: They traveled by Pullman and later by car, from New York to Chicago and California, which he found a pleasure.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How would you normally travel from place to place?

By train. That's in the early times we started by train, pullman. Then we'd get onto where we could drive, and started traveling by cars. We would drive to different towns. See in the year of 1926 and '25 and '23, we were traveling betwixt and between. We would travel sometimes by train and sometimes by car. Over the little sucker we traveled by car to some of the places, too, that are in the city, we could travel by car. We would go from New York to Chicago by car many times. It must have been sort of difficult traveling on the road all the time.
It was nice. It wasn't difficult. Nice.
'Cause it was a pleasure. See the scenery, too. It was nice.
But you had no roots anywhere. You had no family.
